E2931

Two interactive nodes both have the label "{label}"

What

Two interactive nodes both have the label "{label}"

Why

Assistive tech announces controls by their label — identical labels make them indistinguishable (WCAG 2.5.3).

Fix

Give each interactive node a distinct, descriptive label.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2931: tests/ui_lint/a11y_duplicate_label.warn.
